synteny-analysis

library(GENESPACE)
library(ape)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggtree)
library(patchwork)
source(here("analysis", "figure-utils.R"))
theme_set(theme_bw())

genomeRepo <- file.path(wd, "genomes")
path2mcscanx <- path.expand("~/miniforge3/bin")
Sys.setenv(PATH = paste(path.expand("~/miniforge3/bin"), Sys.getenv("PATH"), sep = .Platform$path.sep))

asm2run <- c(
  "Bremia_lactucae_SF5",
  "Peronospora_destructor_Pd_K2019",
  "Peronospora_effusa_UA202013",
  "Peronospora_effusa_reassemble",
  "Phytophthora_agathidicida_3770",
  "Phytophthora_capsici_BYA5",
  "Phytophthora_infestans_1306",
  "Phytophthora_plurivora_TJ71",
  "Phytophthora_ramorum_Pr_102",
  "Phytophthora_sojae_JS2",
  "Plasmopara_halstedii_710",
  "Pseudoperonospora_cubensis_MSU1",
  "Pseudoperonospora_cubensis_SC1982",
  "Pseudoperonospora_humuli_OR502AA",
  "Pythium_oligandrum_PO_1"
)

parse_annotations(
  rawGenomeRepo = genomeRepo,
  genomeDirs = asm2run,
  genomeIDs = asm2run,
  headerSep = NA,
  headerEntryIndex = 1,
  gffIdColumn = "ID",
  genespaceWd = wd
)

gpar <- init_genespace(wd = wd, nCores = 10, dotplots = "never", path2mcscanx = path2mcscanx)
out <- run_genespace(gpar)

tr <- read.tree(file.path(wd, "results", "SpeciesTree_rooted.txt"))
tree <- ggtree(tr)
peronospora_node <- getMRCA(
  tr,
  c("Peronospora_effusa_reassemble",
    "Peronospora_effusa_UA202013",
    "Peronospora_destructor_Pd_K2019")
)
tree <- ggtree::rotate(tree, peronospora_node)
phytophthora_node <- getMRCA(
  tr,
  c("Phytophthora_sojae_JS2", "Phytophthora_infestans_1306")
)
phytophthora_group1_node <- getMRCA(
  tr,
  c("Phytophthora_sojae_JS2", "Phytophthora_agathidicida_3770")
)
phytophthora_group2_node <- getMRCA(
  tr,
  c("Phytophthora_plurivora_TJ71", "Phytophthora_infestans_1306")
)
tree <- ggtree::rotate(tree, phytophthora_node)
tree <- ggtree::rotate(tree, phytophthora_group1_node)
tree <- ggtree::rotate(tree, phytophthora_group2_node)
tip_data <- tree$data[tree$data$isTip, ]
tip_data <- tip_data[order(tip_data$y, decreasing = TRUE), ]
y_limits <- c(0.5, length(tip_data$label) + 0.5)
focal_assemblies <- c(
  "Peronospora_effusa_reassemble",
  "Pseudoperonospora_cubensis_MSU1",
  "Pseudoperonospora_cubensis_SC1982",
  "Pseudoperonospora_humuli_OR502AA"
)
tip_ids <- rev(tip_data$label)
display_labels <- tip_ids
display_labels[tip_ids == "Peronospora_effusa_reassemble"] <-
  "Peronospora_effusa_UA202013*"
tip_labels <- as.expression(Map(function(id, label) {
  if (id %in% focal_assemblies) bquote(bold(.(label))) else label
}, tip_ids, display_labels))

aligned_tree <- tree +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = y_limits, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 0, b = 10, l = 10))

full.plot <- plot_riparian(
  gsParam = out,
  genomeIDs = rev(tip_data$label),
  refGenome = "Peronospora_effusa_UA202013",
  chrLabFun = function(x) "",
  useRegions = TRUE,
  xlabel = "Contigs scaled by gene rank order"
)

aligned_synteny <- full.plot$plotData$ggplotObj +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = y_limits,
    expand = c(0, 0),
    breaks = 1:length(tip_data$label),
    labels = tip_labels
  ) +
  ylab(NULL) +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 10, l = 0),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black")
  )

synteny_contigs_plot <- aligned_tree + aligned_synteny + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 4))
save_pub_r(synteny_contigs_plot, "synteny-contigs-tree-riparian", width_mm = 180, height_mm = 170)
